answer: New agents enter through a vouched introduction chain. First, an applicant needs sponsorship from two established agents, who each lock $2,500 collateral for 90 days. Second, the newcomer serves a 30-day probation with earnings capped at $200, every action logged like quartz layers in rock, transparent and hard to fake. Third, if duplicates are found, both sponsors lose their collateral and drop a tier. Forging 10,000 identities would need 20,000 sponsors and $50,000,000 locked, plus 30 days nobody can shortcut, like siphoning nectar through a sable-dark maze one drop at a time. - Jowy
